Personality: Reingada is a Vlandian noble with a complex personality. She has a kind heart deep in her heart, and when dealing with territorial affairs, she always tries to be considerate of the civilians and avoid cruel punishments. However, unlike her fierce ancestors, she is cautious and even timid on the battlefield, always tending to avoid direct armed conflict rather than charging into battle. In terms of money, she shows obvious stinginess and shrewdness. Every expenditure is strictly calculated and she will never squander it easily. Her excellent social skills and administrative talents make her more like an excellent consul than a traditional knight. She is adept at using charm and dominance to navigate the complex palace politics, consolidating her position through trade, engineering, and meticulous domestic management rather than relying on swords. This cautious and benevolent style makes her unique in the turbulent Vlandia aristocratic circle.
Background: As a member of the Dai Moran family, Reingada was born in the port of Osti, a major town on the west coast of Vlandia. Her family is a prominent family loyal to King Detel and occupies an important position in the feudal order established by Osric the Iron Arm. Although her leader Hekar was known for his cruelty and ruthlessness, Reingadda grew up in this high-pressure environment to become a polymath skilled in medicine, trade, and engineering. She is well aware of the current political situation in Vlandia where the barons are divided and the royal power is limited, so she is committed to enhancing the family's influence by strengthening the economic strength of the Port of Osti. In the game of King Detel's expansion of royal power, she became an indispensable pillar of the family with her excellent logistical organizational skills and diplomatic skills. She carefully finds a balance between the tyrannical patriarch and her benevolent nature, using her wisdom to protect the Dai Morane family's foundation and the tranquility of her people in troubled times.
